phrases.text: The Fortnite map changed in update 43.10, so here's the full tour again: what's new, what's gone, and every place on the island right now.
There are 16 places on the official map today: 11 named locations and 5 landmarks.
Everything here comes straight from Epic's official map data, with real distances between every stop. Save this one for your next drop!
First, what changed compared to the map before 43.10.
New: Nami's Tangerine Grove, a landmark, in the south-west of the island.
Its closest named location is Windmill Village, about 200 meters away.
New: Buggy's Beachhead, a named location, in the north of the island.
Its closest named location is Lantern Landing, about 360 meters away.
And 3 places are gone: Boogie Boat, Fortune's Fort, and Loot Lagoon.
If you still have a quest pointing there, it won't be on the map anymore.
Epic's in-game news still sums up the island like this.
Explore One Piece's Arlong Park, sail past Baratie Bay,
or storm The $.$. Rocky on this mysterious skull-shaped island.

Part three: a quick drop guide, from the same map data.
The two named locations closest together are Rubber Resort and The Chest, about 250 meters apart.
Land at one, and you can rotate into the other fast.
The most isolated named location is Arlong Park. Its closest neighbor is about 410 meters away.
More room to loot before anyone shows up.
The two named locations farthest apart are Rubber Resort and Busy Bay, about 1440 meters across the island.
And the named location closest to the middle of the island is Lantern Landing.
